name: LabelMakerList
job: Present tags, services or ingredients as outlined mono tags that type themselves in one after another
visitor_action: none (prints in view); hover tilts a strip
motion: tags type in character by character with a blinking caret, staggered (reduced-motion: all tags in place)
art_direction: Technical mono: 1px ink-outlined tags on warm paper (#f2f1ec / #111), one accent (#c2410c) for index numbers and caret, JetBrains Mono uppercase
